core_principles: Swiss Rigor: High density, clean lines, and pure functional utility.
Organic Trust: Deep, sophisticated greens replace generic SaaS blues to feel premium and trustworthy.
Data Clarity: The table is the hero. Typography must prioritize legibility of numbers and currency.
No rounded fluff: Crisp corners (max 6px) to maintain an authoritative, enterprise feel.

typography.guidelines: NEVER use Inter. Use Cabinet Grotesk for section headings and KPI labels. Use IBM Plex Mono for all Rupee values and numbers.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) between KPI cards and tables.
layout_and_spacing.cards: border border-border bg-white rounded-md shadow-sm p-5
layout_and_spacing.navigation: Top navbar, sticky, white bg, h-16, flex items-center justify-between, border-b border-border.

tables.header: Dark green/near-black background (#061A11) with white text for high contrast and strong horizontal framing.
tables.cells: Padding py-3 px-4. Align numbers to the right, text to the left.

buttons.primary: bg-primary_dark_green text-white hover:bg-primary_accent hover:text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: border border-border bg-white text-text_main hover:bg-surface_off_white rounded-md px-4 py-2

forms.inputs: border border-border rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary_accent

modals.content: bg-white rounded-lg border border-border shadow-xl p-6 max-w-md w-full

formatting_rules.currency: Indian Rupee (₹). ALL currency values MUST use the Indian numbering system format (e.g., ₹ 1,23,45,678). Use Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN').

testing_attributes.requirement: ALL interactive elements, buttons, links, inputs, and major containers MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup fonts: Install Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, and IBM Plex Mono (or use Google Fonts for IBM, Fontshare for Cabinet Grotesk).
2. Build the Global Navbar: 'Creator Consultant' Logo (text based, Cabinet Grotesk bold), Links (Projects, Clients, Architects, Settings), and CTA (+ New Project, Record Payment).
3. Build the Dashboard View: Top section with 3 KPI Cards (Total Quoted, Received, Outstanding). Ensure Indian Rupee formatting.

4. Build the Data Table: Dark header (black/dark green), sortable columns. Include columns: Project ID, Name, Client, Architect, Site Location, Quoted ₹, Received ₹, Outstanding ₹, Status, Actions (View/Pay/Edit/Delete).
5. Implement Modals/Forms: Create the 'Add Project' form, 'Record Payment' modal, Client and Architect management forms.
6. Do not implement a login flow; the dashboard should be accessible immediately.
7. Rely heavily on Shadcn UI (Tables, Dialogs, Cards) but restyle them with the exact hex codes provided. Strip away default border-radius (use rounded-md) and apply the custom fonts.
